Nora B: FYI QBR ask landed: short 'account health + cost playbook' for three onboarding customers (CobaltWave, Emberlytics, Verdant). Need 1 slide each: burn trend, runway forecast, 3 tactical mitigations. Who can take what?
Tomas L: I can own CobaltWave. Will pull 30/60 trends and check nightly jobs.
Ivy N: Emberlytics assigned to me. I'll focus on embedding churn and function-call hotpaths.
Rishi K: I'll take Verdant and run a quick QPS x seq sensitivity plus a cheap quantization estimate. ETA Wed EOD.
Nora B: Great. Keep it lean: chart + 1-liner "exec takeaway" + one recommended action (throttle / credit / ops fix). Also include a tiny table: projected days until credits at current burn.
Tomas L: For CobaltWave, noticed repeated long-context debug runs from dev env. Suggest capping dev routes to 512 and enabling request sampling.
Ivy N: Emberlytics has a batch embed rebuild every night; that's 55% of their 7d spend. Recommend incremental + sample window.
Rishi K: Running sims with our estimator:
```
./bin/sim_cost --acct VERDANT --horizon 30 --qps 25,50,100 --lens 64,256,1024 --quantize --out verdant-sim.csv
```
Nora B: Also new renewal flag: mark "action" if MoM burn up >35% OR projected runout <28 days. If both, mark "escalate" and suggest one-time $4k buffer (legal pre-cleared for small pilots).
Ivy N: I'll draft the enablement blurb (short, prescriptive) and a preset throttle JSON we can paste into the ops runbook.
Tomas L: Can DataOps grant read to tomas.l@redwood on cobaltwave-prod-billing? Need raw events 90d.
DataOps Bot: access granted to tomas.l@redwood for project cobaltwave-prod-billing.
Rishi K: Uploaded sims to drive: https://drive.redwood/verdant/verdant-sim.csv. Quick headline: 100qps@1024 -> ~$1.5k/day unquantized; quantize ~30% saving. I'll attach a 3x3 sensitivity CSV.
Nora B: Owners recap: CobaltWave=Tomas, Emberlytics=Ivy, Verdant=Rishi, Enablement=Nora. Deliverables due Tue 5pm PT so I can assemble Wed morning. Dry-run Thurs 9am PT. Please flag blockers here. :rocket:
